name: Icon
purpose: Render standardized icons throughout the design system.
intent: Provide one consistent icon system - sizing, spacing, and color inheritance - that every generated glyph shares, instead of each icon reinventing its own props.
useCases: Supporting a text label to speed up recognition
Representing a known object or entity
Improving visual scanning in buttons, tables, navigation
antiPatterns: Standalone unlabeled interactive controls (wrap in Icon Button instead)
Conveying critical meaning without an accessible name
Using an icon as a logo (use Logo)
Hardcoding an icon's fill/size instead of using the shared props

anatomy.description: Sets the icon's container size, spacing box, and color; carries data-size/data-spacing/data-color for downstream CSS overrides.
Rendered only when decorative is false and title is provided; referenced via aria-labelledby.

spacing.description: Hit-box/container padding around the glyph, independent of its visual size.

title.description: Accessible name, used only when decorative is false.

decorative.description: When true, aria-hidden with no role. When false, role=img with title as the accessible name (via aria-labelledby).

className.description: Composes with the root's class list.

none.purpose: Container matches the glyph size exactly.

spacious.purpose: Centers the glyph in a larger, fixed touch/click-target box.

decorative.whenTrue: aria-hidden=true on the svg, no role
decorative.whenFalse: role=img on the svg, aria-labelledby pointing at an internal <title> built from the title prop

requirements: Default to decorative unless the icon is the sole carrier of meaning.
Provide title when decorative is false.
Do not add click handlers or make icons focusable - interactive behavior belongs to the parent (Button, Icon Button, Link).
Do not rely on an icon alone for critical meaning without an accessible name.

behaviorRules: Icons inherit color via currentColor by default; do not hardcode fills.
svg is always focusable="false" - icons are never independently tabbable.
Apply data-size/data-spacing/data-color on the root for downstream CSS overrides (the same mechanism Icon Tile and Icon Button use to force color/size inheritance).
compositionRules: Consumers import the generated per-glyph component (e.g. CheckIcon), not IconBase, directly.
New glyphs are added via npm run generate:icons from SVG sources, not written by hand.
Every generated component shares the exact same IconProps - there is no per-icon prop surface.
themeRules: Color tokens resolve per-theme automatically - no icon-specific dark-mode handling needed.
implementationNotes: Use React.memo for IconBase and every generated icon component.
Icons are primarily used within other components (Button, Tag, Avatar, etc.), not rendered bare at the page level.
do: Pair an icon with a visible label whenever possible.
Use semantic color values only when the icon itself carries that meaning.
Give a standalone icon a title and decorative={false} when it's the only content.
dont: Use an icon as the only label for a control without an accessible name.
Add an iconSize-style prop instead of using the shared size prop.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders the glyph via a generated component sharing the full IconProps set.
Defaults to size=md, spacing=none, color=default, decorative=true.
Supports all IconSize, IconSpacing, and IconColor values.
decorative=false renders role=img with an accessible name from title.
Works in light and dark themes via semantic color tokens.
Storybook includes a Playground, size/spacing/color Variants, and a generated icon gallery grouped by metadata category.
knownLimitations: Only two sizes (sm, md) - components needing a different icon size fix it internally rather than exposing an iconSize prop.
No built-in searchable icon gallery beyond the Storybook Examples story.
futureEnhancements: SVG linting/optimization in the generation pipeline
